scripts.dev: concurrently -n WEB,API -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @nova/web" "npm run dev -w @nova/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nova/web && npm run check -w @nova/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @nova/web && npm run lint -w @nova/api
scripts.render:build: npm ci --include=dev && npm run db:generate -w @nova/api && npm run check -w @nova/api && npm run build -w @nova/web
